labels.notes: Unmarked, partial: right. No ``**`label`**`` occurs in any of the three files, and the label cannot be closed because l.1353-1355 is false. PORT: I compared statements at declaration level, not only line sets. All 160 declarations of lean-gx/GX/BTZ/Causality.lean l.116-1646 at c48aa45 (a hub commit; the file is unchanged since) are present as Causal.E0.<same name>. Each statement (header up to ':=') is textually identical, and every non-blank line of the range occurs verbatim in the port. The only line missing is l.1647, which is the next section's header. The docstrings' gx line partition (E0Model / E0Causality / E0Axioms) checks for all 160. Name resolution: the only gx-level (non-GX.E0) names in the range are btzPaperNull, nullToMink and minkQ. No unqualified token of the range is a Causal top-level name, so moving the code under `namespace Causal` cannot rebind an identifier. btzPaperDev (Model l.1408), btzPaperNull (l.1413), btzPaperDev_eq_nullToMink (l.1416), nullToMink (Bridge l.88), nullToMink_apply (l.113) and minkQ_nullToMink (l.123) are restated identically. minkQ_nullToMink's RHS is gx's `nullQ y` unfolded (Quotient.lean:2952). There are 25 new declarations, as the REPORT says. The three files import no GX.* module. ASSERTIONS VS LEAN. (1) 'lightlike: locally causal, not locally chronal' is read as: axis_causalCurveOn (every axis segment in an open W is a future causal curve of W), and not_chronalCurveOn_axisLine (no non-degenerate axis segment is chronal in any W). This is non-vacuous: chronal curves exist off the axis (clt_of_seg, Iplus_ball_axis). (2) I^-_U(p) = ∅ is proved for every open U, which is stronger than printed. J^-(p) = {r = 0, τ ≤ τ_p} is proved globally, and J^-_U(p) ⊂ axis for every U. (3) p ∈ Z^+ \ Z^- uses the library's Zplus/Zminus, which are def:strongly_tarentin_point verbatim. (4) Not past distinguishing is proved for E₀ itself, and abstractly under SingularFlatAxioms with sing 0 nonempty (minor finding 4). (5) The printed I^+(p) = J^+(p) \ sing₀ is refuted (Iplus_ne_Jplus_diff, not_btzIplusAsPrinted), and its repair is proved (Iplus_axis_eq_interior_diff). btzAxioms has type exactly `Causal.E0.causality.BTZAxioms Causal.E0.axis`, with no binder or hypothesis. The field set is the library's as of DEC-64 (f84b69e): singularPastAt, Iminus_eq_empty, Iplus_of_lt, past_local, line. `line` gives the closed embedding unconditionally. le_iff_btzPaperDev says what it claims: Le x y iff some developments D(τ, r, θ) of x and y are related by (Causal.minkowski 2).le ⊤. The causal_E0 assembly is honest: its conjuncts are the above, and its docstring says 'E₀ is not past distinguishing', which is the model case. It is not presented as a full anchor. FINDINGS CHECKED. (a) l.1353-1355 is false. This is DEC-64's finding, already in the row's ledger paper_findings since f84b69e ('by hand, not formalized'). The Lean witness Iplus_ne_Jplus_diff already existed in gx at c48aa45. What is new in lean-causal: the witness inside the ETT library, the Prop BTZIplusAsPrinted (kb/0022), and the repair I^+(p) = Int J^+(p) \ sing₀. The repair is correct for the BTZ model: Int J^+(p) = {f > τ_p} by interior_Jplus_axis, and removing the axis leaves {r > 0, f > τ_p} = I^+(p). The refutation does not depend on the metric reading. The printed metric -dτ² + dr² + r²dθ² is Minkowski 3-space in cylindrical coordinates, where J^+(p) \ {r = 0} also contains the null cone of p. The repair, however, is BTZ-specific: in Minkowski, Int J^+(p) \ {r = 0} drops the points of the timelike line above p, which do lie in I^+(p). (b) l.1348-1349 is true as an editorial point. The displayed facts concern the past only, and Z^+ needs I^+(p) ∩ U ≠ ∅. The claim itself holds (mem_Zplus), and the REPORT says so. This finding is new; the ledger does not record it. (c) The metric finding is correctly marked as already recorded. READINGS. All four are listed as questions and disclosed in SCOPE. None makes a statement vacuous or easier. - 'past distinguishing' (I^-(x) = I^-(y) ⇒ x = y, global I^-) is the standard and weakest form, so its negation is the strongest reading of 'not past distinguishing'. - 'white hole = BTZ point' matches the time orientation: future means r increasing, and I^-(p) = ∅ on the line. - The flat extreme-BTZ metric -2dτdr + dr² + r²dθ² is the pullback of Minkowski by D; I recomputed it. - The DEC-33 curve reading is the (G,X)-structure's own notion. Two of the readings are marked ✓ in the checklists rather than ⚠ (minor finding 3).

build.details: `lake env lean -DwarningAsError=true` on each of E0Model, E0Causality and E0Axioms exits 0 with no output. A control copy of E0Causality with one injected `sorry` fails as it should, so the run really elaborates the file. `lake build --no-build` of the three modules: 'All targets up-to-date (2373 jobs)'. The closer's oleans match the sources and nothing upstream moved. `sorry` occurs once, in E0Axioms docstring prose ('no `sorry` in this file'). There is no sorry/admit/axiom/unsafe/opaque/implemented_by/extern/native_decide. A probe importing `Causal` together with CausalScaffold.Port.E0Axioms ran #print axioms on 31 declarations: btzAxioms, causal_E0, Iplus_ne_Jplus_diff, not_btzIplusAsPrinted, le_iff_btzPaperDev, lt_iff_btzPaperDev, Iplus_axis_eq_interior_diff, interior_Jplus_axis, not_pastDistinguishing, Causality.SingularFlatAxioms.not_pastDistinguishing, absolutelyMinimalOn, tarentin, causallyArcConnected, isOpen_Jplus/Jminus, calculus_le/lt, mem_Zplus, mem_Zminus_iff, Jplus/Iplus/Jminus/Iminus_axis, mem_Zplus_not_mem_Zminus, axis_causalCurveOn, not_chronalCurveOn_axisLine, Iplus_ball_axis, isOpen_CLt_right/left, nullCone_sub_iff_le, btzPaperDev_eq_nullToMink. Every one depends on exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. The probe also produced no name clash with `import Causal`, and `example : Causal.E0.causality.BTZAxioms Causal.E0.axis := Causal.E0.btzAxioms` elaborates. Both probes were written under campaign/T-ett-port-e0/ and deleted. As the closer notes (kb/0025), the three modules are not yet imported by scaffold/CausalScaffold.lean, so the sweep does not see them until the master adds them.

findings.what: 'btzAxioms ... the first instance with a non-empty BTZ locus' is false. The strict library has had Causal.lightlikeLine_btzAxioms : lightlikeLine.BTZAxioms (univ : Set ℝ) since f101385 (Causal/SingularFlat.lean:620), with S₀ = ℝ, and SingularFlat's own SCOPE (l.125-126) records it. gx's docstring was already wrong, and the closer repeated the claim in the new module docstring and in a kb proposal, where it would become standing knowledge.
findings.fix: In the new module docstring and the kb proposal, say 'the first instance on a 3-dimensional model of the paper (E₀), with BTZ points that have a non-empty chronological future'. The verbatim gx docstring can stay, with a note, or be corrected upstream in gx.

findings.what: The finding is DEC-64's. It is already recorded in the row's ledger paper_findings (f84b69e), and the Lean witness Iplus_ne_Jplus_diff already existed in gx at c48aa45. The REPORT finding never names DEC-64 as the source; only the E0Axioms SCOPE (a) does ('DEC-64's finding, now a theorem'). Curated as written, it would reach the author a second time. The new content is the repair I^+(p) = Int J^+(p) \ sing₀ and the Prop BTZIplusAsPrinted, and both are correct. The finding also reverses its notation: 'Only the inclusion ⊂ (every non-BTZ point of J^+(p) is in I^+(p)) fails; I^+(p) ⊂ J^+(p) \ sing_0 holds'. The failing inclusion is ⊇, as the parenthesis itself says. One fact strengthens the finding: it also holds under the printed metric, which is Minkowski 3-space in cylindrical coordinates, where J^+(p) \ {r = 0} contains the null cone of p. The repair does not survive that reading, because in Minkowski it drops the timelike line above p.
findings.fix: Reword the finding as 'DEC-64's finding (ledger), now a Lean theorem in lean-causal; new: the exact repair I^+(p) = Int J^+(p) \ sing₀'. Change '⊂' to '⊇'. Optionally add that the refutation does not depend on the metric reading, while the repair is specific to the BTZ model.

findings.what: The checklists mark two readings ✓: the meaning of 'future causal curve' in E₀ (DEC-33 as gx reads it), and 'locally causal, but not locally chronal'. The REPORT lists both as questions, and the same files mark the other readings ⚠ ('past distinguishing', 'white hole', the metric). kb/0006 reserves ✓ for a carried hypothesis.
findings.fix: Mark both rows '⚠ read: …', pointing to the SCOPE item and the REPORT question.

findings.what: The abstract form assumes SingularFlatAxioms with sing 0 nonempty. The library records that this structure has no witness in lean-causal (Causal/SingularFlat.lean:119-123). The E₀ instance is owed by T-ett-port-e0-sfa; gx has it through singularFlatAxioms_of_pushUp and GX.E0LM.e0_pushUp, so the hypotheses are satisfiable, just not yet inside lean-causal. The REPORT presents the abstract form beside the concrete one without saying this (kb/0011: a theorem about a predicate is worth what its inhabitants are worth). The concrete Causal.E0.not_pastDistinguishing is unaffected.
findings.fix: Add one sentence to SCOPE (c) and to the REPORT row: the abstract form is instantiated with a BTZ point only once T-ett-port-e0-sfa lands, and until then the model case E0.not_pastDistinguishing is the evidence.
